title: Micah Parsons not happy that Jordan Love was ranked as the No. 72 player in the NFL

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Micah Parsons not happy that Jordan Love was ranked as the No. 72 player in the NFL
sources.description: The NFL is currently unveiling the result of its annual Top 100 players survey, and Packers linebacker Micah Parsons is not happy with where his fellow players ranked his quarterback.
